about.tagline: Path of Exile price checker (PoE1 / PoE2, International / Taiwan realms)
about.report_hint: Opens a pre-filled GitHub issue (version and environment only; nothing is sent automatically).
about.license_failed: Failed to load the license file: {error}
about.thanks_intro: This tool is built on the following projects; please consider supporting their authors too.
about.apt: PoE1 clipboard parser, filters, trade queries and data files
about.apt_zh: Traditional Chinese fork of Awakened PoE Trade (PoE1 zh-TW data)
about.ee2: PoE2 clipboard parser, filters, trade queries, data files and icons
about.ee2_zh: Traditional Chinese fork of Exiled Exchange 2 (PoE2 zh-TW data)
about.poenavi: Design reference: unified PoE1 / PoE2 price check flow (no code copied)
about.pobtools: Poe Regex search-string algorithm and data (same author)
about.pob_poe2: PoE2 desecrated modifier tier data derived from its Data/*.lua
about.disenchant: Disenchant ranking: gold fees, inventory slots, inherent-influence inference and dust values for cross-checking
about.alserom: poe-dust table (source of poe-disenchant-tool dust values)

regex.mode_none_tip: "None of" builds an exclusion string (leading !) that hides items carrying these modifiers.
regex.bilingual_tip: Show the other language under each row
regex.select_all_tip: Tick all {n} rows that pass the current filter
regex.output_hint: Paste into the in-game search bar
regex.over_limit: Over the limit, untick some rows
regex.lang_tip: Which client language the string is for. The two produce completely different fragments and are not interchangeable.
regex.unresolved: {n} picks cannot be targeted on their own
regex.unresolved_why: Another row prints exactly the same text, or every usable fragment of this line also appears in text every item carries (modifier names, tiers, reminder text, tags such as Corrupted), so the game search cannot hit it alone.
regex.tokens_hint: The brackets only show leading and trailing spaces; do not type them
regex.bm_elsewhere_tip: Switch the game above to see them
regex.bm_empty: No {game} bookmarks yet. Tick a set you use often and press "Save as bookmark" to recall it later.
regex.bm_orphans: {n} bookmarks are on lists this version does not ship and are hidden (still kept in regex_state.json).
regex.bm_update_tip: Overwrite this bookmark with the current list, mode and picks
regex.notice_loaded_missed: Loaded bookmark "{name}", but {n} of its rows are not in the current data (the league update may have changed them).
regex.notice_updated: Bookmark "{name}" now holds the current picks.
regex.notice_update_empty: Nothing is ticked, so the bookmark was not updated (use Delete to remove it).
regex.notice_missing_page: The list "{page}" of bookmark "{name}" does not exist in this version; not loaded.
regex.notice_restore_missed: {n} of your last picks ({page} and others) are not in the current data; the league update may have changed them.

page_note.map_mods: Tick the modifiers you want and paste the string into the stash search bar. The fragments avoid every other modifier on this list, and the modifier names, tiers, tags, reminder text and map names the game also searches.
page_note.logbook_mods: Tick the logbook modifiers you want. The fragments avoid every other modifier on this list, and the modifier names, tiers, reminder text and logbook names the game also searches.
page_note.waystone_mods: Tick the modifiers you want and paste the string into the stash search bar. The no-false-hit guarantee only covers the other modifiers on this list.
page_note.tablet_mods: All eight tablet types share one list, grouped by tablet. The "Any" group can roll on every tablet; Irradiated tablets only roll that group. The no-false-hit guarantee only covers the other modifiers on this list.
page_note.relic_mods: Relic modifiers for the Trial of the Sekhemas. The no-false-hit guarantee only covers this list.
page_note.expedition_relic_mods: Expedition relic upsides and downsides. The no-false-hit guarantee only covers this list.
page_note.map_numeric: Numeric conditions on map property lines (tier, quantity, rarity…). Each tick is its own condition (all must hold). Labels come from GGPK clientstrings; the separator and "+" display have not been confirmed in game.
page_note.waystone_numeric: Numeric conditions on waystone property lines (tier, rarity, pack size…). Each tick is its own condition (all must hold). Labels come from GGPK clientstrings; the separator and "+" display have not been confirmed in game.
page_note.vendor_items: Links, socket colours, item level, quality, corrupted and influence. Each tick is its own condition (all must hold). The socket rows assume the zh client shows R-G-B untranslated (untested).
page_note.vendor_items_poe2: Item level, quality, corrupted and gem level. Each tick is its own condition (all must hold).

regex.template_apply_warn: This replaces every {game} list's picks, values, custom text, exclusions and mode.
regex.share_copy_tip: Pack the picks, values, custom text and exclusions of every list of this game into one code
regex.share_paste_tip: Paste a code someone gave you and apply it
regex.share_paste_warn: Applying replaces the picks of every list of that code's game.
regex.out_scope_tip: Combined = every list with picks merged into one string; Single = only the current list
regex.custom_unverified: Custom text is not verified and may match other items.
regex.algo_hint: Each tick is its own condition (all must hold). Editing a value ticks the row.
regex.untested_tip: Assumes the Traditional Chinese client shows sockets as R-G-B (letters and - untranslated); not yet confirmed in game.
regex.combined_empty: Nothing is ticked yet. Tick rows in "Single list", apply a template or paste a share code.
regex.custom_hint: Each item is its own condition (all must hold), matched literally
regex.excludes_hint: Merged into the single exclusion (!): items with any of them are skipped
regex.conflict_ambient: Fragment "{text}" hits text every item carries
regex.conflict_fragment: {page}: a condition fragment also hits a modifier line ({text})
regex.conflict_exclude: {page}: an exclusion hits a ticked modifier ({text})
regex.conflict_invalid: {page}: the input of "{text}" is invalid and was skipped
regex.notice_template_missed: Applied template "{name}", but {n} items are not in the current data (missing lists: {pages}).
regex.notice_share_missed: Applied share code ({name}), but {n} items are not in the current data (missing lists: {pages}).
regex.notice_combo_not_loaded: The {game} lists are not loaded yet; cannot apply.

dust.low_confidence: Only {count} listings on poe.ninja; price is a rough guide
dust.splitter: Drag (or press Up/Down) to resize the disenchant ranking
dust.title: Disenchant ranking
dust.tw_hint: poe.ninja has no Taiwan-realm prices; the ranking uses International prices (switch to International to see prices; dust only for now)
dust.poe1_only: Disenchanting is PoE1 only; switch to PoE1 for priced rankings
dust.no_league: No poe.ninja prices for this league (none selected or private league); ranking by dust only
dust.save_failed: Failed to save disenchant panel state: {error}
dust.opt_catalyst_tip: Rings / amulets / belts only get quality from catalysts. Auto: compare "no quality" with "buy 20 of the cheapest catalyst to reach 20%" and keep the one with more dust per total cost
dust.opt_gold_value_tip: Chaos per 1000 gold; only affects "Dust / total" (0 = ignore the disenchant fee; with a value set, uniques without gold data from poe-disenchant-tool get no value for this metric)
dust.metric_dust_total_tip: Dust ÷ (item price + gold fee in chaos + catalysts)
dust.catalyst_used_tip: Buying 20 {name} ({unit} c each, {cost} c total) to reach 20% quality pays off
dust.catalyst_skip_tip: Cheapest catalyst is {name} ({unit} c each); disenchanting at 0% is more efficient
dust.low_conf_tip: poe.ninja has only {n} listings; treat the price as a rough guide
dust.inherent_inf_tip: This unique always carries {n} influence type(s) (inferred from poe-dust values); dust includes +50% per influence. Single-item price check uses the item text instead
dust.trade_tip: Search the trade site (name + base, min item level, corrupted, listed within)
dust.assumption: poe.ninja prices are mostly low item level, uncorrupted listings; dust uses the item level / quality above, so the ranking is an estimate of what you could buy. Disenchant values come from APT data; gold fee and slots from poe-disenchant-tool.
